visual_logic.composition: A quadrant tiled composition: Top-Left (Birth): A soft-bodied, pale larva (grub) hatching from soil; Top-Right (Dining): The beetle using sharp mandibles to crunch through the shell of a smaller insect; Bottom-Left (Sleeping): Tucked under a flat piece of purple mudstone, antennae retracted; Bottom-Right (Activity): The beetle navigating a 'canyon' created by a large dinosaur's footprint in the mud.
visual_logic.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; focus on the mechanical, 'tank-like' movement of the legs; vibrant metallic sheen on the wing cases.
